chunks.title: SecureVault AI — overview
chunks.text:
Project: SecureVault AI (Security Lab). Status: Live — Shipped and publicly available.
Next-gen cloud security platform. File encryption meets AI-powered threat detection — AES-256-GCM encryption that runs locally, an AI threat scanner, biometric login, a blockchain key vault and zero-knowledge sharing.
Source code: https://github.com/Nausheen1295/securevault-ai
Live demo: https://securevaultai-brown.vercel.app

chunks.title: SecureVault AI — problem & solution
chunks.text:
Project: SecureVault AI (Security Lab). Status: Live — Shipped and publicly available.
Solution: Encrypt files on the user's own device so they never leave it, and pair that with automated threat scanning, passwordless biometric login and auditable key storage.

chunks.title: SecureVault AI — features
chunks.text:
Project: SecureVault AI (Security Lab). Status: Live — Shipped and publicly available.
Features:
- AES-256-GCM file encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation (310k iterations)
- Random salt & IV per file; batch file processing; 100% local — files never leave your device
- AI threat scanner: Shannon entropy analysis, file-signature matching, confidence scoring
- VirusTotal API integration
- Biometric authentication via WebAuthn (fingerprint / platform authenticators) — zero biometric data stored
- Blockchain key vault on the Ethereum Sepolia testnet with MetaMask, immutable audit trail and key revocation
- Zero-knowledge sharing: password never in the share URL, expiring links, max view count, one-click revocation, checksum verification
- Security analytics: real-time security score, threat history charts, event audit log, risk dashboard

chunks.title: SecureVault AI — architecture
chunks.text:
Project: SecureVault AI (Security Lab). Status: Live — Shipped and publicly available.
Architecture components:
- User (client): Signs in with a password or a WebAuthn platform authenticator (fingerprint / face). No biometric data is stored by the app.
- React + Vite app (frontend): Single-page app built with React 18 and Vite 5, deployed on Vercel. Hosts the dashboard, scanner, vault and sharing UI.
- Encryption engine (ai): AES-256-GCM with keys derived through PBKDF2 (310k iterations) and a random salt + IV per file. Runs locally, so files never leave the device.
- AI threat scanner (ai): Analyses files with Shannon entropy and signature matching, produces a confidence score, and can cross-check with the VirusTotal API.
- Serverless API (api): The repository contains an api/ directory alongside the Vercel config. Its exact responsibilities are not documented yet.
- Blockchain key vault (data): Key records are stored on the Ethereum Sepolia testnet through MetaMask, giving an immutable audit trail with support for key revocation.
- VirusTotal (external): External threat-intelligence service used by the scanner for additional verification.
Data flow: user → frontend; frontend → crypto; frontend → scanner; frontend → api; scanner → virustotal; frontend → chain.

chunks.title: Stock Price Prediction — problem & solution
chunks.text:
Project: Stock Price Prediction (AI Lab). Status: Completed — Finished project with public source code.
Problem: Investors want to know where the market is heading, but forecasting stock prices is notoriously hard.
Solution: Predict the next-day return from engineered price features, compare against naive and drift baselines, and check statistical significance and a simple trading simulation before trusting any model.

chunks.title: Stock Price Prediction — features
chunks.text:
Project: Stock Price Prediction (AI Lab). Status: Completed — Finished project with public source code.
Features:
- Exploratory analysis: trends, return distribution, volatility, correlations and autocorrelation
- 20 engineered features: lagged returns, moving-average gaps, momentum, volatility, RSI and S&P 500 returns
- Chronological split: train 70% (2007–2013), validation 15%, test 15% (Oct 2014 – Feb 2016)
- Models: Naive and Drift baselines, Ridge Regression, Random Forest and an LSTM (Keras)
- Metrics: RMSE, MAE, MAPE, R², directional accuracy, a binomial significance test and a trading simulation

chunks.title: Stock Price Prediction — engineering decisions
chunks.text:

Engineering decisions:
- Predict next-day return rather than price, then convert back: price = today's close × (1 + predicted return)
- Split the data chronologically (no shuffling) so the test set is genuinely in the future

chunks.title: Stock Price Prediction — results
chunks.text:
Project: Stock Price Prediction (AI Lab). Status: Completed — Finished project with public source code.
Results: On the 339-day test set no model beat the naive baseline on RMSE (naive 1.903 vs Random Forest 1.911, LSTM 1.923). Random Forest predicted direction best at 53.4%, but this is not statistically significant (p ≈ 0.12) — consistent with the Efficient Market Hypothesis. Educational project only, not financial advice.

chunks.title: Tech World E-Commerce — README: Tech World
chunks.text:
Project: Tech World E-Commerce. Status: In development. Source: project README.
# Tech World
**Live website:** https://corizo-store.onrender.com
Tech World is a full-stack e-commerce website for electronics: phones, laptops,
tablets, wearables and accessories. Customers can browse products, manage a
shopping cart and place cash-on-delivery orders. Store administrators manage
products, stock, orders and customers from a dashboard.
> The site is hosted on Render's free plan. If it has been idle, the first page
> load can take up to a minute while the server wakes up.

chunks.title: Tech World E-Commerce — README: For customers
chunks.text:
Project: Tech World E-Commerce. Status: In development. Source: project README.
### For customers
- Browse the product catalogue with live search and category filters
- Create an account, log in and log out securely
- Add products to the cart, change quantities and remove items
- See stock availability and cart totals update instantly
- Check out with a shipping address and pay by cash on delivery
- View order history with order status and payment status

chunks.title: Tech World E-Commerce — README: For administrators
chunks.text:
Project: Tech World E-Commerce. Status: In development. Source: project README.
### For administrators
- Dashboard with active products, total orders, orders to process and revenue
- Add, edit, hide and restore products
- Upload product images straight from the dashboard
- Update order status (Pending → Confirmed → Shipped → Delivered, or Cancelled)
- Stock is returned automatically when an order is cancelled
- View all registered customers

chunks.title: Tech World E-Commerce — README: Security
chunks.text:
Project: Tech World E-Commerce. Status: In development. Source: project README.
### Security
- Passwords are hashed with bcrypt and never stored in plain text
- Login sessions are stored in the database with secure, HTTP-only cookies
- Admin pages and actions are protected on the server
- Prices and stock are always checked on the server, never trusted from the browser

chunks.title: Student Management App — README: Run Locally
chunks.text:
Project: Student Management App. Status: Completed. Source: project README.
## Run Locally
1. Install Node.js.
2. Clone this repository.
3. Install the dependencies:
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```
4. Create a `.env` file in the project root:
   ```env
   MONGO_URI=YOUR_MONGODB_ATLAS_CONNECTION_STRING
   PORT=5000
   ```
5. Replace the placeholder with your own MongoDB Atlas connection string.
6. Start the development server:
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```
7. Open `http://localhost:5000` in your browser.
